values.binNote: Channel duration not present in sheet; only castTime (0.25) is listed, which is separate from the 3-second channel.

mechanics.claim: Requiem's cooldown starts on cast, not on completion of the channel.
The ability deals damage to all targetable enemy champions upon completion of the channel, not during it.
mechanics.quote: deals {{as|magic damage}} to all targetable enemy champions upon completion

mechanics.claim: Karthus is silenced/immobilized during the channel, and any interrupting damage or crowd control stops the cast (per the channel interaction table).
